# OutReign — Find Who to Sell To. Then Actually Sell to Them.
# https://outreign.io
# Last Updated: 2026-08-01
# For complete product documentation: https://outreign.io/llms-full.txt

> OutReign is sales operations software for B2B outbound teams, a unified alternative to stitching together Apollo, Instantly, Outreach, and Salesloft. Describe your ideal customer in plain English, get ranked prospects with SMTP-verified business emails, and send an AI-drafted first-touch message from one workflow in under 2 minutes.

## About OutReign

OutReign was built by Brandon Yakubov, a founder who was spending $500 a month on Apollo and still spending hours manually scoring leads and writing emails from scratch. OutReign replaces that fragmented workflow (lead search, email enrichment, ICP scoring, and email drafting) in a single tool.

OutReign is email-only. We do not provide phone numbers, cold calling tools, or SMS. Our focus is helping B2B sales teams find the right people to email, verify those emails are real, and write something worth reading.

## How It Works

1. **Describe your ICP in plain English**: Type who you want to reach: job title, industry, company size, geography, or hiring signals. No boolean search, no filter UI.
2. **Review prospects ranked by ICP fit**: OutReign scores each prospect against your Ideal Customer Profile and returns a ranked list with company context and growth signals.
3. **Get SMTP-verified business emails**: Every email address is verified via SMTP handshake plus multi-source enrichment before it reaches you.
4. **Send an AI-drafted first-touch email**: OutReign writes a personalized first-touch email using the prospect's role, company news, and signals. Edit in under 30 seconds and send.
5. **Track replies and manage follow-up**: Replies, sequences, and follow-up tasks stay organized. Sync with HubSpot, Salesforce, or Gmail automatically.

## Key Features

- **Plain-English ICP search**: Describe your target customer naturally, no boolean syntax or filter juggling.
- **ICP fit scoring**: Every prospect is scored against your ICP so you know who to email first.
- **SMTP-verified email enrichment**: Emails verified via SMTP handshake plus multi-source validation before delivery.
- **AI-drafted first-touch emails**: Personalized drafts written from the prospect's company context and growth signals.
- **Email quality checker**: Pre-send scoring on spam triggers, readability, and personalization.
- **Reply management**: Replies and follow-ups organized in one place, with AI-drafted responses on Growth and above.
- **Sequence automation**: Multi-step email sequences with send-time optimization, plus branching and A/B testing on Pro and above.
- **AI SDR agent**: An autonomous email rep included on every plan (volume and autonomy scale by tier) that sources leads, sends the first touch, classifies replies, and responds in your voice.
- **CRM integrations**: HubSpot and Salesforce sync on Pro and above. Gmail, Slack, Calendly, and Zapier connect on paid plans.

## AI SDR Agent

The AI SDR agent is an autonomous email sales rep built into OutReign, included on every plan, with volume and autonomy scaling by tier. It sources leads that match your ICP, writes and sends the first-touch email from your Gmail, then monitors threads, classifies prospect replies, and replies in your voice. Every reply passes a spam and deliverability check before it sends.

- **Explore Agent (Free)**: 1 agent build, sources 25 leads per day, drafts first-touch emails and up to 3 replies per day for your approval, 120-minute minimum reply delay.
- **Starter Agent**: 1 agent build, sources 100 leads per day, sends outreach autonomously, 15 autonomous replies per day, 60-minute minimum delay.
- **Growth Agent**: 3 agent builds (each with its own ICP, persona and campaign label), 300 leads per day, 50 autonomous replies per day, objection handling, 30-minute minimum delay.
- **Pro Agent**: 5 agent builds, 750 leads per day, 150 autonomous replies per day, objection handling plus automatic meeting booking via Calendly, buying-committee mapping and why-now research, 10-minute minimum delay.
- **Elite Agent (Agency)**: Unlimited agent builds, unlimited lead sourcing, 500 autonomous replies per day, fully autonomous full-cycle outreach with priority processing, 5-minute minimum delay.

## What OutReign Does NOT Do

- Cold calling or phone number enrichment
- SMS outreach
- LinkedIn automation
- Social media management

## Pricing

Pricing scales by verified prospects contacted per month, not per seat. Seats are unlimited on all paid plans. Monthly and yearly billing are both available, and yearly saves 20%.

- **Explore (Free, $0/month)**: 100 lead searches per month, up to 25 results per search, 100 emails per month, view-only dashboard, summary analytics, help center access. No AI SDR agent. No credit card required.
- **Starter ($39/month)**: 1,000 verified prospects per month, 100 per day, 50,000 emails per month. Prospect search and verified emails, ICP Builder (3 profiles), email quality checker, AI email generator, sequence templates, standard support.
- **Growth ($89/month)**: 2,500 verified prospects per month, 250 per day, 250,000 emails per month. Everything in Starter plus unified reply inbox with AI drafts, deliverability dashboard and warmup, ICP lookalike discovery, ICP Builder (10 profiles), AI personalized outreach, priority support. Includes the Growth AI SDR agent.
- **Pro ($179/month)**: 5,000 verified prospects per month, 500 per day, 1,000,000 emails per month. Everything in Growth plus sequence branching and A/B testing, unlimited ICP profiles, CRM integrations, team collaboration, premium support. Includes the Pro AI SDR agent.
- **Agency ($249/month)**: 15,000 verified prospects per month, 1,500 per day, unlimited emails. Everything in Pro plus white-label client portal, branded PDF reports, client portal sharing without login, referral and reseller program, priority API access, dedicated account support. Includes the Elite AI SDR agent.

All four paid plans start with a 14-day free trial and carry a 30-day money-back guarantee. Explore is free forever and needs no trial.

One-time credit packs are available with no subscription required: 200 prospects for $37.50, 400 prospects for $67.50, or 600 prospects for $90.

## Trust & Security

- 256-bit TLS encryption in transit
- SMTP-verified business emails (no unverified data delivered)
- GDPR-ready infrastructure
- SOC 2 compliant hosting (Supabase)
- 14-day free trial and 30-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans
- No credit card required to start Explore

## FAQ

**Does OutReign require boolean search or SQL?**
No. You describe your target customer in plain English. OutReign interprets your intent and returns ranked matches.

**How does OutReign verify email addresses?**
Every business email is verified via SMTP handshake plus multi-source enrichment. We do not deliver addresses we haven't verified.

**Is OutReign only for email outreach?**
Yes. OutReign is email-only. We do not provide phone numbers, cold calling features, or SMS tools.

**How does AI email drafting work?**
OutReign pulls the prospect's role, company context, and growth signals to write a first-touch email. You edit it in under 30 seconds and send. It references real context, not a template with a name swapped in.

**What's the difference between OutReign and a contact list?**
A list gives you volume. OutReign gives you the right people, ranked by ICP fit, with verified emails and a draft already written for each one.

**Can I try OutReign before paying?**
Yes. The Explore plan is free forever and lets you run the full workflow with 100 lead searches a month and no credit card. Every paid plan also starts with a 14-day free trial, so you can use the full plan for two weeks before your first charge.

**Is there a free trial and a money-back guarantee?**
Yes. All four paid plans start with a 14-day free trial, and every paid plan carries a 30-day money-back guarantee after your first charge.
